newsitem.title: UK: UK natgas sets new output record in Dec - WoodMac.
newsitem.headline: UK natgas sets new output record in Dec - WoodMac.

text.p: UK gas production set a new record in December at 12,245 million cubic feet a day (Mmcfd), up 1 percent on the previous record of 12,074 Mmcfd set last February, consultants Wood Mackenzie said on Monday
And the average for the whole of 1996 was 8,367 Mmcfd, up by 1,193 Mmcfd or 17 percent from the 1995 figure of 7,174 MMcfd.
The Morecambe fields, operated by British Gas plc produced at a record daily average of 2,088 Mmcfd, up from a previous record of 2,019 Mmcfd in February 1996.

The increase in Morecambe output accounted for 40 percent of the total increase in UK roduction between November and December. Wood Mackenzie said the rise in Morecambe production was likely to be aimed at optimising the tax position of the fields as well as representing a response to a cold snap in December.
Production was up from the majority of gas fields, and strong demand led to the release of 201 Mmcfd from the Rough Storage facility.

The Trent and Tyne fields were producing fully for the first time in December, with output of 27 Mmcfd and 88 Mmcfd respectively. The fields are expected to produce at least 415 billion cubic feet over 14 years.
